protocol.key_to_shard: SHA256(UTF8 key), first 8 bytes big-endian, modulo shard_count
protocol.logical_bytes: UTF8 key length plus synthetic value length; excludes all storage/transfer framing and retry state
protocol.relative_demand: sum of (rank+1)^-1.1; synthetic popularity weights, not executed requests
protocol.placement_hash: MD5 first 4 bytes little-endian, shared by both policies
protocol.ketama: equal-weight MD5 continuum; four little-endian u32 points per group-label-replica digest; first point >= key hash with wraparound
protocol.collision_tie: lexicographically first group label at identical ring position

limits: No network I/O, consensus, state transfer, measured latency or physical bytes.
Fixed shards move as units; continuum point count does not change shard count.
Equal group weights and declared labels only; three key populations are not three independently randomized rings.
A controller must commit any chosen route and complete fenced handoff before serving at the new owner.
